name: Al'Aketh Thugs
summary: At the temple ruins near Thendal Grove, Al'Aketh cultists threaten travelers. Sent from the Shrine of Akir under High Priestess Lorthuna's orders, they harass wayfarers and force recruits into their ranks. Hanaa Nightwind asks you to break their hold and slay their commander.

sections.title: Cultist Ruffians in the Ruins
sections.body: Just southwest of Thendal Grove, ancient temple ruins have become dangerous for travelers. The Al'Aketh have seized the grounds and prey on people near the grove. Rangers stationed nearby suspect High Priestess Lorthuna sent the ruffians from the Shrine of Akir. They bully the people and force them to submit to the cult.

sections.title: Malduko Cloudcrush
sections.body: At the ruins, Malduko Cloudcrush rules through violence and fear. Brutes and newly indoctrinated neophytes obey him, making the temple an aggressive outpost at Thendal Grove's doorstep. Hanaa Nightwind hopes that striking down Cloudcrush and scattering his followers will break the cult's confidence. It will warn them that coercion will not be tolerated in these lands.

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh are a fanatical cult operating on Zephras. High Priestess Lorthuna leads them from the Shrine of Akir. Her followers use intimidation and violence to force travelers and residents to join.

faq.q: Why are the cultists attacking Thendal Grove?
faq.answer: The cultists have camped in temple ruins southwest of Thendal Grove. There, they ambush travelers leaving the area and terrorize people on the road. They hope to pressure locals into submitting to the cult.
Malduko Cloudcrush leads the Al'Aketh encampment at the temple ruins. Hanaa Nightwind calls him a monster. He directs the brutes and neophytes who prey on nearby roads.
Hanaa Nightwind is a Ranger guarding Thendal Grove. She remains at her post along the road and warns travelers of the nearby ambush. She depends on capable adventurers to clear the threat.

faq.q: Who sent these cultists to the ruins?
faq.answer: Hanaa suspects High Priestess Lorthuna sent the cultists from the Shrine of Akir. Lorthuna oversees cult activities there.

faq.q: What else can be found near the temple ruins?
faq.answer: An active Ley Line lies within the ancient ruins at the southwest end of the area, alongside the Al'Aketh encampment.
